lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.19 - A Listen and read

details: Listen and read allows students to review the usage of ‘there is/are’ and prepositions of place.
Look for students following the text (with their eyes, or a finger) while they listen, and clear pronunciation, steady pacing, and correct identification of each word while they read.
“My mum always puts a lot of fruit and vegetables in my lunch! Let’s listen and find out what these children have for lunch.”

Heads Up (Reading): 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and help Ss to understand the text by asking questions, practicing skimming (reading for gist), scanning (reading for specific information) and detail (reading for comprehension). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.19 - B Choose the correct answers

details: Choose the correct answers checks students’ understanding of the text and gives them an opportunity to practise reading for understanding.
Look for correct circling/writing of the answers and the ability to identify where in the text they found the answers.
“I love eating fruit!. What about these children? Can you help me to choose the  correct answers?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

Look for accurate pronunciation of the sound, correct identification of the pictures and correct isolation of their first sound.

lessonPlan.topic: Phonics Book pp.107 - 109 - A Match and trace

details: Match and trace reinforces comprehension of the CVC words by linking sound to meaning. Students show understanding by matching the pictures to the words.
Look for correct identification of the pictures, consistent letter formation, and neat handwriting within the lines.
“Where have all these extra words come from? Can you help me choose the ones that match the pictures?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.

lessonPlan.topic: Phonics Book pp.107 - 109 - A Colour v purple. Colour w pink. Colour qu yellow.

details: This activity develops letter recognition. Students show understanding by matching colours to words that begin with certain letters.
Look for the correct colours used for words beginning with the letters specified.
“I think they had a party in our classroom. They left lots of balloons here! Can you help me sort them out?”
